content:
As children prepare to head back to school or university, the back-to-school sales season offers a great opportunity to pick up tech products to help them tackle all their studies.

Apple launched its own back-to-school promotion last month, offering a US$150 gift card with the purchase of select Mac or iPad models, while Amazon also has plenty of bargains to choose from.

We've rounded up a selection of tech products suited for students heading back to school — details below.

inateck AceTouch — an ultra-light, multi-colour keyboard case for iPad

If you want to add a case, screen protector, stand and keyboard to your iPad at an affordable price, the inateck AceTouch does it all in one. It can turn your iPad into a portable laptop for working on the go.

A keyboard is the best accessory for boosting iPad productivity, and the AceTouch is a fully featured, Mac-style keyboard with function keys and a clickable trackpad (98 x 55mm) that supports all Apple shortcuts. You can use the trackpad to drag, scroll, zoom and switch between full-screen apps. Palm-rejection technology prevents accidental touches.

Snap on for laptop mode, snap off for tablet mode.

A magnetic detachable design lets the keyboard attach automatically, and removing it takes just one second. Combined with a flexible stand that adjusts from 20 to 70 degrees, it supports both landscape and portrait viewing angles for any scenario — multiple functions in one case.

The AceTouch is 200g lighter than other full-featured keyboards, weighing just 450g with a thickness of only 0.3 inches. Its scissor-switch keys have a travel of just 1.5mm for fast, comfortable typing. The lightweight body fits easily into any backpack for daily carry.

It is compatible with the iPad (A16) 11th generation, 10th-generation iPad, 10.9-inch iPad Air (4th and 5th generation), 11-inch iPad Air (M2 to M4), and 11-inch iPad Pro (1st to 4th generation).

Pick your colour and show off your style. The keyboard features a modern minimalist design with nine vibrant colour options and a slim profile, adding personality to your iPad.

Anker Nano Power Strip

The Anker Nano Power Strip is a compact 10-in-1 device that can power multiple Apple devices on your desk at the same time.

Its clever clamp design lets you secure it exactly where you need it, with the main body hidden under the desk. The visible part is smaller than an iPhone 17 Pro Max and slimmer than AirPods Pro 3.

You can power your MacBook, monitor, iPad, iPhone, AirPods and more at the same time via a combination of power outlets and USB ports. GaN charging technology delivers up to 70W of output, while built-in surge and overload protection with instant power-off keeps your devices safe.

ESR 3-in-1 Charging Station

If you want a minimalist charging solution for your bedside, the ESR 3-in-1 Charging Station can power your iPhone, Apple Watch and AirPods charging case simultaneously.

The Qi 2.2 charger delivers up to 25W of charging power to the latest iPhone models, and is of course compatible with all older MagSafe iPhones. Built-in CryoBoost cooling technology reduces device temperature during charging, helping to extend battery life. The fan can be turned off for silent overnight operation.

Supports all Apple Watch models and all AirPods cases with wireless charging. The device also works well as a travel charger — folded down, it measures just 4.33 x 2.44 x 0.62 inches.

Apple AirPods Max 2

The AirPods Max 2 is the latest generation of Apple's premium over-ear headphones, featuring active noise cancellation (ANC), Adaptive Audio, personalised Spatial Audio and live translation.

The headphones feature a breathable knit-mesh headband, memory foam and custom fabric ear cushions, paired with telescoping arms for a comfortable, perfect fit. Available in five vibrant colours.

Anker Soundcore Liberty 5

AirPods are undoubtedly one of the most popular in-ear headphones around, but if you're looking for a more affordable option, the Anker Soundcore Liberty 5 noise-cancelling earbuds are a great alternative.

They combine real-time adaptive active noise cancellation, fast charging and long battery life. When listening to music, hi-res audio, LDAC, HearID Sound 4.0 and Dolby Audio work together to enhance the sound with greater depth and detail. For calls, six microphones paired with AI-enhanced active noise cancellation deliver clearer conversations. Multipoint connectivity lets you switch quickly and easily between devices.

The earbuds offer up to 12 hours of battery life on a single charge, extending to 48 hours with the charging case. A 10-minute quick charge gives you 5 hours of use.

AirTags 2nd Generation 4-Pack

AirTags are a great way to keep track of your luggage, camera and other valuable or important items when out and about. This deal lets you pick up the latest 2nd-generation 4-pack at a superb price.

MagSafe PopSockets

PopSocket grips are currently one of the most popular iPhone accessories, offering a safe, secure way to hold your phone one-handed, while also doubling as a stand.

A metallic enamel coating gives a clean, premium look, with a wide selection of colours and patterns available.

Oeli XTREM E-Ink Screen iPhone Case

Last but not least, a fun one. The Oeli XTREM is a different kind of iPhone case: it has a built-in e-ink display that can be customised via a dedicated app.

It requires no extra battery — it draws power from the phone via NFC. Like all e-ink screens, it uses no power to display an image; electricity is only needed when refreshing the display, so it has virtually no impact on your phone's battery life.

You can choose from your own photos or designs created by other users in the app's community. You can also mirror your iPhone's screen, allowing you to use the rear camera for selfies.
